svg.title: More large ships enter the Mississippi and the Houston Ship Channel than any other corridor, but only about 300 reach Baton Rouge and 490 reach Houston

cc:Work.dc:title: More large ships enter the Mississippi and the Houston Ship Channel than any other corridor, but only about 300 reach Baton Rouge and 490 reach Houston
cc:Work.dc:description: Fifteen falling step lines, one per river or ship channel, of distinct large ships seen at or beyond each point against distance scaled to the head port; the Mississippi starts near 4,500 and the Houston Ship Channel near 3,750, and both end in the hundreds.
